title: Role of KLF4 in Neutrophil Aging in Periodontitis with Metabolic Syndrome
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Metabolic syndrome (MetS) and periodontitis (PD) are major interconnected health burdens, and the inflammatory interplay between them remains elusive. Neutrophils, central to periodontal immunity, can undergo functional alterations contributing to disease ...
